ValidationRule.description: Lock the contract payment record from editing when the Proposal status is "Accepted by Customer.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Corporate_Contract_Payments', ISPICKVAL(Proposal__r.Status__c,'Accepted by Customer'), OR( ISCHANGED(Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Paid_As__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Criteria__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Frequency__c), ISCHANGED(Proposal__c), ISCHANGED(Type__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't edit the record when the status is "Accepted by Customer"
